tour.step1Desc: Click any card to inspect full text, images, and metadata, or select multiple items to compare diffs.
tour.step2Desc: You're in mini mode — many features are hidden. We strongly recommend clicking this button to switch to full view and explore everything!
tour.stepShowPanelDesc: The side panel is currently hidden. Click "Next" to open it and explore preview and comparison features.
tour.step3Desc: Don't need the side panel? Click here to close it and focus on browsing history and favorites.
tour.step4Desc: Scroll the mouse wheel on the title bar to adjust window transparency in real time.
tour.step5Desc: Click here to keep the window always on top, handy for quick access and pasting.
tour.step6Desc: Click here to open a quick input window — jot down ideas and temporary content, auto-saved to clipboard history.
tour.step7Desc: Press Alt+X anytime to show or hide the main panel without reaching for the mouse. You can customize this shortcut in Settings > Shortcuts.
tour.step8Desc: Configure an AI provider and API Key in Settings to enable smart tags, summaries, and more.
tour.step9Desc: You can replay this tour anytime from Settings > General > Guided Tour. Enjoy using Qollect!
